leadText:
(Japanese: ウッシー Uschi) is a minor character who appeared in Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction. In the English subtitles, he was merely referred to as a shopper.

He is a porter who bumped into and when they followed around the Orsay City mall. He almost dropped his gift packages, but the others quickly grabbed them and returned them to him.

Uschi is based on his Japanese voice actor , a now-retired footballer who played for the Japanese national team and participated in the and s, which the latter tournament was on course during the premiere of the film. A reference is made in that he is seen carrying a soccer ball.
